question: What is the company's remote work policy?
answer: Employees are allowed to work remotely up to 3 days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are mandatory in-office days.

question: How many vacation days do I get?
answer: All full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year, plus 10 standard public holidays.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, visit the IT self-service portal at myit.company.com and click 'Forgot Password'. You will need access to your secondary authentication device.

question: Where is the main office located?
answer: Our main headquarters is located at 123 Tech Boulevard, Silicon Valley, CA 94043.
